Extract genomic DNA from the cell pellet as per manufacturer’s instructions. QuickExtract (Epicentre) is recommended due to its scalability and ease-of-use. 30 µL is usually sufficient for small cell pellets (<50,000 cells), and any samples which are overly viscous after thermocycling may be diluted with DNase-free water.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Clonal Isolation
steps.instruction: Prepare one well of 80% confluent post-transfected cells from a 6-well plate using an Accutase split.

steps.title: Prepare Seeding Plates
steps.instruction: Aspirate Matrigel solution from two 6-well plates. Add 2 mL of E8 supplemented with 10 µM Y-27632 ROCK inhibitor to all wells except the final well, which should remain empty.

steps.title: Perform Serial Dilution Seeding
steps.instruction: Resuspend Accutase-dissociated cells (after centrifuging and aspirating supernatant) in 2 mL of E8 supplemented with 10 µM Y-27632 ROCK inhibitor, then perform a one-half dilution series across the wells.

substeps.instruction: Add the full 2 mL of cells and medium to the first well (A1) and pipet up and down twice to mix.
Transfer 2 mL of this mixture into the second well and mix by pipetting up and down twice.
Continue pipetting and mixing for each subsequent well to perform a one-half dilution.
Dispense the final 2 mL into the empty well.

steps.title: Incubate and Maintain Colonies
steps.instruction: Return plates to the incubator, shake gently (front-to-back and side-to-side), and monitor colony formation daily via phase-contrast microscope.

substeps.instruction: Replace medium with fresh culture medium once a majority of colonies contain at least 8 cells.
Change medium after 1 day for wells seeded with ≥50,000 cells; change after 3 days for wells seeded with <5,000 cells.

steps.title: Identify and Mark Clones
steps.instruction: On day 3 to 4, identify compact, round, well-spaced colonies and mark them using a Cell Dotter (1.8-mm rings) under a 10× objective.

substeps.instruction: For fluorescent markers, ensure colonies are at least 500 µm in diameter.
Mark 10 to 20 clones (or 50 to 100 for label-free editing).

steps.title: Clean and Pick Colonies
steps.instruction: Remove unwanted cells in close proximity to marked colonies, then pick the desired clones into a 24-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Pick-to-remove any cells within or immediately surrounding the marking ring.
Check growth daily and perform 'pick-to-keep' around days 5 to 7 when colonies match the interior of the marking ring.
Rinse wells once with PBS and add at least 5 mL medium to each well before picking.
Prepare a 24-well plate by aspirating Matrigel and loading each well with 250 µL of E8 supplemented with 10 µM Y-27632 ROCK inhibitor.
Pick-to-keep each colony into an individual well of the 24-well plate.

steps.title: Expand and Split Clones
steps.instruction: Grow cells in the 24-well plate for 5 to 7 days until colonies are at least 2 mm in diameter, then perform an EDTA split.

substeps.instruction: Discard clones with excessive spontaneous differentiation (brown centers).
Prepare clones for splitting using 250 µL of 0.5 mM EDTA in PBS.

steps.title: Collect Genomic DNA and Re-seed
steps.instruction: Divide the dissociated cells between a genomic DNA collection tube and a new growth well.

substeps.instruction: During EDTA incubation, prepare a labeled microcentrifuge tube for each clone and a new growth well (ideally a 12-well plate, or two 24-well plates for backup) loaded with one-half volume E8 supplemented with 10 µM Y-27632 ROCK inhibitor.
Aspirate EDTA and gently dissociate cells by pipetting 1 mL of medium 2-3 times with a P1000 tip.
Deposit half of the medium into the microcentrifuge tube and the other half into the new growth well.
Return plates to the incubator and shake gently.

steps.title: Extract and Validate Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate genomic DNA and verify the transgenic line via PCR and sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the microcentrifuge tube for 5 minutes at room temperature, ensuring consistent pellet orientation.
Aspirate as much medium as possible using a filterless pipet tip or P1000.
Perform PCR using 1 µL of QuickExtract solution in a 10-µL PCR preparation.
Run samples on an agarose gel to confirm amplification; discard clones that fail to amplify the test fragment but amplify the positive control.
PCR purify and Sanger sequence clones with positive initial genotyping to confirm integration.

steps.title: Expand and Cryopreserve Confirmed Clones
steps.instruction: Expand clones with positive PCR results and create frozen backups.

substeps.instruction: Expand clones via EDTA splitting 1:4 into larger wells at 50% to 60% confluency.
For clones in two 6-well plate wells at 80% confluency, prepare both for an EDTA split.

Prepare a recipient plate with E8 + 10 µM Y-27632, a 15-ml conical tube with 1 mL medium containing components for 3 mL cryopreservation medium (e.g., 300 µL DMSO and 700 µL E8), and three labeled cryovials.
Detach cells from one well with 3 mL medium; transfer 0.5 mL to two wells (1:6 split) for maintenance.
Use the remaining 2 mL medium and cells to detach the second well and add to the 15-ml conical tube to create 1× cryopreservation medium.
Add 1 mL to each of the three cryovials and freeze.
Further expand sequence-confirmed clones to a full 6-well plate and freeze into 6-8 vials.
